sha256:82650d48badf564a397765e67d4189238.en: Scrcpy is an open-source application for mirroring and controlling Android devices from a computer. It works via USB or WiFi connection without requiring root access. The tool uses FFmpeg for video encoding and SDL2 for display, providing low latency screen sharing. It supports device control, screen recording, and clipboard synchronization. Scrcpy is compatible with Android 5.0 and above, offering a lightweight alternative to manufacturer-specific solutions.
sha256:82650d48badf564a397765e67d4189238.zh: Scrcpy是一款开源应用程序，用于在计算机上镜像和控制Android设备。它通过USB或WiFi连接工作，无需root权限。该工具使用FFmpeg进行视频编码，SDL2进行显示，提供低延迟的屏幕共享。它支持设备控制、屏幕录制和剪贴板同步功能。Scrcpy兼容Android 5.0及以上版本，为制造商特定解决方案提供了轻量级替代方案，适用于开发测试和日常设备管理。
sha256:82650d48badf564a397765e67d4189238.es: Scrcpy is an open-source application for mirroring and controlling Android devices from a computer. It works via USB or WiFi connection without requiring root access. The tool uses FFmpeg for video encoding and SDL2 for display, providing low latency screen sharing. It supports device control, screen recording, and clipboard synchronization. Scrcpy is compatible with Android 5.0 and above, offering a lightweight alternative to manufacturer-specific solutions.

sha256:6ff733a3ec47f154a7fa277cf5e6537ee.en: yt-dlp is a Python-based command-line audio/video downloader that extends youtube-dl with additional features. It supports downloading from numerous websites including YouTube, with capabilities for extracting metadata, subtitles, and thumbnails. The tool includes SponsorBlock integration to skip sponsored segments and offers extensive customization options for format selection and post-processing. It is actively maintained with frequent updates to handle site changes.
sha256:6ff733a3ec47f154a7fa277cf5e6537ee.zh: yt-dlp 是一个基于 Python 的命令行音视频下载工具，扩展了 youtube-dl 的功能。它支持从包括 YouTube 在内的众多网站下载内容，具备提取元数据、字幕和缩略图的能力。该工具集成了 SponsorBlock 功能以跳过赞助片段，并提供广泛的格式选择和后期处理自定义选项。项目持续维护，频繁更新以应对网站变化，适用于需要批量下载或特定格式转换的用户场景。
sha256:6ff733a3ec47f154a7fa277cf5e6537ee.es: yt-dlp is a Python-based command-line audio/video downloader that extends youtube-dl with additional features. It supports downloading from numerous websites including YouTube, with capabilities for extracting metadata, subtitles, and thumbnails. The tool includes SponsorBlock integration to skip sponsored segments and offers extensive customization options for format selection and post-processing. It is actively maintained with frequent updates to handle site changes.

sha256:1d9fe88d4f1b8aa97fc1e36177d15c3a8.en: 30-seconds-of-code is an educational repository containing concise JavaScript code snippets and programming articles. It covers various web development topics including ES6 features, DOM manipulation, Node.js, and algorithms. The collection aims to help developers quickly learn practical coding techniques through short, understandable examples. Content is organized by categories and includes implementations for common programming tasks and best practices.
sha256:1d9fe88d4f1b8aa97fc1e36177d15c3a8.zh: 30-seconds-of-code 是一个教育性代码库，包含简洁的 JavaScript 代码片段和编程文章。它涵盖各种 Web 开发主题，包括 ES6 特性、DOM 操作、Node.js 和算法。该集合旨在通过简短易懂的示例帮助开发者快速学习实用的编码技巧。内容按类别组织，包含常见编程任务和最佳实践的实现，适用于不同技能水平的程序员作为学习参考和日常开发工具。
sha256:1d9fe88d4f1b8aa97fc1e36177d15c3a8.es: 30-seconds-of-code is an educational repository containing concise JavaScript code snippets and programming articles. It covers various web development topics including ES6 features, DOM manipulation, Node.js, and algorithms. The collection aims to help developers quickly learn practical coding techniques through short, understandable examples. Content is organized by categories and includes implementations for common programming tasks and best practices.

sha256:e4fcb1fe144cb1c54700501030aba6c9c.en: Langflow is an open-source tool for creating and deploying AI agents and workflows. It provides a visual interface using React Flow for designing complex AI systems. The platform supports integration with large language models and multi-agent architectures. Users can build custom AI applications through drag-and-drop components. The project focuses on workflow automation and agent-based AI solutions. It enables development of generative AI applications with modular components.
sha256:e4fcb1fe144cb1c54700501030aba6c9c.zh: Langflow 是一个用于构建和部署人工智能代理与工作流程的开源工具。该项目采用 React Flow 提供可视化界面，支持设计复杂的 AI 系统。平台能够集成大型语言模型和多代理架构，用户可通过拖放组件构建自定义 AI 应用。该工具专注于工作流自动化和基于代理的 AI 解决方案，支持模块化组件开发生成式 AI 应用。项目提供了灵活的配置选项和部署功能。
sha256:e4fcb1fe144cb1c54700501030aba6c9c.es: Langflow is an open-source tool for creating and deploying AI agents and workflows. It provides a visual interface using React Flow for designing complex AI systems. The platform supports integration with large language models and multi-agent architectures. Users can build custom AI applications through drag-and-drop components. The project focuses on workflow automation and agent-based AI solutions. It enables development of generative AI applications with modular components.

sha256:21f1ab396c75bd7182ad2912a81449966.en: React Native is an open-source framework developed by Facebook for building native mobile applications. It enables developers to create apps for both iOS and Android platforms using JavaScript and React. The framework allows code sharing between platforms while maintaining native performance. Developers can build mobile interfaces using familiar React components and patterns. It provides access to native platform APIs and device capabilities. The project supports cross-platform mobile development with a single codebase.
sha256:21f1ab396c75bd7182ad2912a81449966.zh: React Native 是由 Facebook 开发的开源移动应用框架，用于构建原生移动应用程序。该框架允许开发者使用 JavaScript 和 React 技术栈同时为 iOS 和 Android 平台创建应用。它支持跨平台代码共享，同时保持原生应用的性能表现。开发者可以使用熟悉的 React 组件和模式构建移动界面，并访问原生平台 API 和设备功能。该项目为移动开发提供了统一的代码库解决方案，简化了多平台应用开发流程。
sha256:21f1ab396c75bd7182ad2912a81449966.es: React Native is an open-source framework developed by Facebook for building native mobile applications. It enables developers to create apps for both iOS and Android platforms using JavaScript and React. The framework allows code sharing between platforms while maintaining native performance. Developers can build mobile interfaces using familiar React components and patterns. It provides access to native platform APIs and device capabilities. The project supports cross-platform mobile development with a single codebase.

sha256:992ef56210a98d8623feb030a74556f30.en: Microsoft PowerToys is a collection of utilities designed to enhance Windows customization and improve productivity. It includes tools like Color Picker for selecting colors, FancyZones for window management, Keyboard Manager for remapping keys, and PowerRename for batch file renaming. These utilities help users streamline common tasks and personalize their Windows 10/11 desktop experience without requiring advanced technical knowledge.
sha256:992ef56210a98d8623feb030a74556f30.zh: Microsoft PowerToys 是一套实用工具集合，旨在增强 Windows 系统的自定义功能并提高工作效率。它包含多种工具：Color Picker 用于颜色选取，FancyZones 用于窗口布局管理，Keyboard Manager 支持键盘按键重映射，PowerRename 提供批量文件重命名功能。这些工具帮助用户简化日常操作，个性化 Windows 10/11 桌面环境，且无需专业技术知识即可使用。
sha256:992ef56210a98d8623feb030a74556f30.es: Microsoft PowerToys is a collection of utilities designed to enhance Windows customization and improve productivity. It includes tools like Color Picker for selecting colors, FancyZones for window management, Keyboard Manager for remapping keys, and PowerRename for batch file renaming. These utilities help users streamline common tasks and personalize their Windows 10/11 desktop experience without requiring advanced technical knowledge.

sha256:2f6ce69d5313ea2829016fcefd951c339.en: Electron is an open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop applications using web technologies. Developers can create apps with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS while leveraging Chromium for rendering and Node.js for backend functionality. This approach allows building applications that run consistently on Windows, macOS, and Linux from a single codebase, making it popular for creating desktop versions of web applications.
sha256:2f6ce69d5313ea2829016fcefd951c339.zh: Electron 是一个开源框架，用于使用 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用程序。开发者能够使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 进行开发，同时利用 Chromium 处理渲染和 Node.js 提供后端功能。这种方法使得可以从单一代码库创建在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上一致运行的应用程序，因此深受需要将 Web 应用转换为桌面版本的开发者欢迎。
sha256:2f6ce69d5313ea2829016fcefd951c339.es: Electron is an open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop applications using web technologies. Developers can create apps with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS while leveraging Chromium for rendering and Node.js for backend functionality. This approach allows building applications that run consistently on Windows, macOS, and Linux from a single codebase, making it popular for creating desktop versions of web applications.

sha256:2ab7e7d6e84aca989415ebfbd4c431203.en: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration platform designed for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. Its core capabilities include automated scheduling, self-healing, service discovery, load balancing, and rolling updates. Key strengths encompass portability across cloud providers, declarative configuration, and robust scalability. Typical use cases involve managing microservices architectures, deploying stateful applications, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring high availability for production workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
sha256:2ab7e7d6e84aca989415ebfbd4c431203.zh: Kubernetes是一个开源容器编排平台，专为自动化部署、扩展和管理容器化应用而设计。其核心能力包括自动调度、自我修复、服务发现、负载均衡和滚动更新。主要优势体现在跨云提供商的可移植性、声明式配置和强大的可扩展性。典型应用场景涵盖微服务架构管理、有状态应用部署、持续集成/持续交付流水线实施，以及在混合云和多云环境中确保生产工作负载的高可用性。该平台支持复杂的应用生命周期管理，提供统一的API接口和灵活的扩展机制，
sha256:2ab7e7d6e84aca989415ebfbd4c431203.es: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration platform designed for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. Its core capabilities include automated scheduling, self-healing, service discovery, load balancing, and rolling updates. Key strengths encompass portability across cloud providers, declarative configuration, and robust scalability. Typical use cases involve managing microservices architectures, deploying stateful applications, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring high availability for production workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

sha256:6844c740299a78470c79ed55b65bc62e9.en: LangChain is a Python framework for developing applications powered by language models. Its purpose is to enable the creation of context-aware reasoning applications by chaining multiple components together. Core capabilities include prompt management, memory for conversation history, and integration with various data sources. Strengths include extensive model support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), modular architecture, and robust tooling for complex workflows. Typical use cases include chatbots, document analysis, code generation, and AI assistants that require contextual understanding and multi-step reasoning.
sha256:6844c740299a78470c79ed55b65bc62e9.zh: LangChain是一个用于开发基于语言模型应用的Python框架，旨在通过链接多个组件来构建具备上下文感知能力的推理应用程序。其核心功能包括提示词管理、对话记忆系统以及多种数据源的集成。主要优势在于支持广泛的模型（如OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini）、模块化架构以及处理复杂工作流程的强大工具集。典型应用场景包括智能聊天机器人、文档分析系统、代码生成工具以及需要上下文理解和多步推理的人工智能助手，能够有效协调不同组件完成复杂任务。
sha256:6844c740299a78470c79ed55b65bc62e9.es: LangChain is a Python framework for developing applications powered by language models. Its purpose is to enable the creation of context-aware reasoning applications by chaining multiple components together. Core capabilities include prompt management, memory for conversation history, and integration with various data sources. Strengths include extensive model support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), modular architecture, and robust tooling for complex workflows. Typical use cases include chatbots, document analysis, code generation, and AI assistants that require contextual understanding and multi-step reasoning.

sha256:17d1837fc91f9534b31c1531fcdb1ac62.en: D3 is a JavaScript library for creating dynamic, interactive data visualizations in web browsers using SVG, Canvas, and HTML. It provides powerful data-driven transformations and animations, enabling developers to bind data to DOM elements and apply data-driven changes. The library supports various chart types and custom visualizations through its extensive API for manipulating documents based on data.
sha256:17d1837fc91f9534b31c1531fcdb1ac62.zh: D3是一个JavaScript库，用于在Web浏览器中使用SVG、Canvas和HTML创建动态交互式数据可视化。它提供强大的数据驱动转换和动画功能，使开发人员能够将数据绑定到DOM元素并应用数据驱动的更改。该库通过其广泛的API支持各种图表类型和自定义可视化，用于基于数据操作文档。D3不提供预定义图表，而是提供构建块来创建自定义可视化。
sha256:17d1837fc91f9534b31c1531fcdb1ac62.es: D3 is a JavaScript library for creating dynamic, interactive data visualizations in web browsers using SVG, Canvas, and HTML. It provides powerful data-driven transformations and animations, enabling developers to bind data to DOM elements and apply data-driven changes. The library supports various chart types and custom visualizations through its extensive API for manipulating documents based on data.

sha256:5aaaf36bcdf3757d99cd7f77519857bed.en: Three.js is a cross-browser JavaScript library and API used to create and display animated 3D computer graphics in a web browser. It uses WebGL for rendering but also supports SVG, CSS3D, and other technologies. The library simplifies working with 3D graphics by providing abstractions for cameras, lights, materials, and geometries, making complex 3D scenes accessible through JavaScript without requiring deep WebGL knowledge.
sha256:5aaaf36bcdf3757d99cd7f77519857bed.zh: Three.js是一个跨浏览器JavaScript库和API，用于在Web浏览器中创建和显示动画3D计算机图形。它主要使用WebGL进行渲染，但也支持SVG、CSS3D和其他技术。该库通过提供相机、灯光、材质和几何体的抽象简化了3D图形工作，使复杂的3D场景可以通过JavaScript访问，无需深入的WebGL知识。Three.js支持虚拟现实、增强现实和多种音频功能，适用于游戏、数据可视化和交互式3D体验。
sha256:5aaaf36bcdf3757d99cd7f77519857bed.es: Three.js is a cross-browser JavaScript library and API used to create and display animated 3D computer graphics in a web browser. It uses WebGL for rendering but also supports SVG, CSS3D, and other technologies. The library simplifies working with 3D graphics by providing abstractions for cameras, lights, materials, and geometries, making complex 3D scenes accessible through JavaScript without requiring deep WebGL knowledge.

sha256:eca703fea03efe9c0a47bc6a9b1ad1133.en: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for JavaScript, compatible with both browsers and Node.js. It simplifies making HTTP requests by providing a clean API for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE operations. Features include request/response interception, automatic JSON data transformation, and client-side XSRF protection. It supports async/await syntax and handles request cancellation. Widely used in web development for its reliability and ease of integration with various frameworks.
sha256:eca703fea03efe9c0a47bc6a9b1ad1133.zh: Axios 是一个基于 Promise 的 HTTP 客户端，适用于浏览器和 Node.js 环境。它通过简洁的 API 简化了 HTTP 请求的发送，支持 GET、POST、PUT、DELETE 等操作。功能包括请求和响应拦截、自动 JSON 数据转换、客户端 XSRF 防护。支持 async/await 语法，并能处理请求取消。因其可靠性和易于与各种框架集成，在 Web 开发中被广泛使用。
sha256:eca703fea03efe9c0a47bc6a9b1ad1133.es: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for JavaScript, compatible with both browsers and Node.js. It simplifies making HTTP requests by providing a clean API for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE operations. Features include request/response interception, automatic JSON data transformation, and client-side XSRF protection. It supports async/await syntax and handles request cancellation. Widely used in web development for its reliability and ease of integration with various frameworks.

sha256:0906b9dfa800c5c1791ac43108c748183.en: Excalidraw is a virtual whiteboard application for creating hand-drawn style diagrams and sketches. It operates in the browser with a focus on simplicity and collaboration. Features include real-time multi-user editing, export to PNG/SVG formats, and customizable elements like shapes and text. The interface mimics physical whiteboards with rough, sketch-like visuals. It's open-source and supports offline functionality, making it suitable for team brainstorming and diagramming sessions.
sha256:0906b9dfa800c5c1791ac43108c748183.zh: Excalidraw 是一个虚拟白板应用，用于创建手绘风格的图表和草图。它在浏览器中运行，注重简洁性和协作功能。特性包括实时多用户编辑、导出为 PNG/SVG 格式、可自定义的形状和文本等元素。界面模拟物理白板，具有粗糙的草图式视觉效果。该项目是开源的，支持离线功能，适用于团队头脑风暴和图表绘制会议。
sha256:0906b9dfa800c5c1791ac43108c748183.es: Excalidraw is a virtual whiteboard application for creating hand-drawn style diagrams and sketches. It operates in the browser with a focus on simplicity and collaboration. Features include real-time multi-user editing, export to PNG/SVG formats, and customizable elements like shapes and text. The interface mimics physical whiteboards with rough, sketch-like visuals. It's open-source and supports offline functionality, making it suitable for team brainstorming and diagramming sessions.

sha256:f0eed562b4619767960daa2528aabdda2.en: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript developed by Microsoft that adds static typing and type checking capabilities. It compiles to clean JavaScript code that runs in any browser or JavaScript runtime. The language helps developers catch errors during development through its type system while maintaining full compatibility with existing JavaScript code. It supports modern ECMAScript features and provides enhanced tooling for large-scale application development.
sha256:f0eed562b4619767960daa2528aabdda2.zh: TypeScript 是由微软开发的 JavaScript 超集语言，为 JavaScript 添加了静态类型系统和类型检查功能。它能够编译生成纯净的 JavaScript 代码，可在任何浏览器或 JavaScript 运行时环境中执行。该语言通过类型系统帮助开发者在开发阶段发现错误，同时保持与现有 JavaScript 代码的完全兼容性。TypeScript 支持现代 ECMAScript 特性，并为大型应用程序开发提供了增强的工具支持，包括更好的代码补全和重构功能。
sha256:f0eed562b4619767960daa2528aabdda2.es: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript developed by Microsoft that adds static typing and type checking capabilities. It compiles to clean JavaScript code that runs in any browser or JavaScript runtime. The language helps developers catch errors during development through its type system while maintaining full compatibility with existing JavaScript code. It supports modern ECMAScript features and provides enhanced tooling for large-scale application development.

sha256:5c350d62886728da2e71079e465869839.en: Deno is a modern runtime environment for JavaScript and TypeScript, created by the original developer of Node.js. It is built with Rust and provides secure execution by default, requiring explicit permission for file, network, and environment access. Deno supports TypeScript natively without additional tooling and includes a standard library. It uses ES modules as the primary module system and aims to address security and developer experience limitations found in Node.js.
sha256:5c350d62886728da2e71079e465869839.zh: Deno 是一个现代化的 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 运行时环境，由 Node.js 的原始开发者创建。它使用 Rust 语言构建，默认提供安全的执行环境，要求对文件、网络和环境访问进行明确的权限授权。Deno 原生支持 TypeScript，无需额外的构建工具，并包含一个标准库。该系统采用 ES 模块作为主要模块系统，旨在解决 Node.js 中存在的安全性和开发者体验方面的限制，同时提供改进的模块管理和依赖处理机制。
sha256:5c350d62886728da2e71079e465869839.es: Deno is a modern runtime environment for JavaScript and TypeScript, created by the original developer of Node.js. It is built with Rust and provides secure execution by default, requiring explicit permission for file, network, and environment access. Deno supports TypeScript natively without additional tooling and includes a standard library. It uses ES modules as the primary module system and aims to address security and developer experience limitations found in Node.js.

sha256:f42a9d67c3baf2dd8d66ec51a09db2cba.en: Node.js Best Practices is a comprehensive GitHub repository containing guidelines for Node.js development. It covers ES6 features, testing with Jest and Mocha, Express.js frameworks, microservices architecture, and REST API development. The project includes code style guides, ESLint configurations, and npm package management recommendations. With over 100,000 stars, it serves as a community-driven reference for JavaScript developers seeking to implement industry-standard coding practices and maintainable application structures.
sha256:f42a9d67c3baf2dd8d66ec51a09db2cba.zh: Node.js 最佳实践是一个全面的 GitHub 代码库，包含 Node.js 开发的指导原则。该项目涵盖 ES6 特性、使用 Jest 和 Mocha 进行测试、Express.js 框架、微服务架构和 REST API 开发。包含代码风格指南、ESLint 配置和 npm 包管理建议。拥有超过 10 万星标，作为社区驱动的参考资源，为 JavaScript 开发者提供行业标准的编码实践和可维护的应用程序结构指导。该项目定期更新，确保内容符合当前技术发展趋势。
sha256:f42a9d67c3baf2dd8d66ec51a09db2cba.es: Node.js Best Practices is a comprehensive GitHub repository containing guidelines for Node.js development. It covers ES6 features, testing with Jest and Mocha, Express.js frameworks, microservices architecture, and REST API development. The project includes code style guides, ESLint configurations, and npm package management recommendations. With over 100,000 stars, it serves as a community-driven reference for JavaScript developers seeking to implement industry-standard coding practices and maintainable application structures.

sha256:8f8d5894ad4be5f4f58a2ff91357b70b5.en: Create React App is a command-line tool developed by Facebook for quickly setting up React applications. It provides a pre-configured build environment with zero configuration requirements, allowing developers to start new projects with a single command. The tool handles build configurations, development servers, and production optimizations automatically. It supports modern JavaScript features and includes essential development tools, enabling developers to focus on writing application code rather than managing build setups and dependencies.
sha256:8f8d5894ad4be5f4f58a2ff91357b70b5.zh: Create React App 是 Facebook 开发的命令行工具，用于快速搭建 React 应用程序。该工具提供预先配置的构建环境，无需额外配置，开发者可通过单一命令启动新项目。自动处理构建配置、开发服务器和生产环境优化。支持现代 JavaScript 特性，包含必要的开发工具，使开发者能够专注于编写应用程序代码，而无需管理构建设置和依赖项。该项目简化了 React 应用的初始设置流程，提高了开发效率。
sha256:8f8d5894ad4be5f4f58a2ff91357b70b5.es: Create React App is a command-line tool developed by Facebook for quickly setting up React applications. It provides a pre-configured build environment with zero configuration requirements, allowing developers to start new projects with a single command. The tool handles build configurations, development servers, and production optimizations automatically. It supports modern JavaScript features and includes essential development tools, enabling developers to focus on writing application code rather than managing build setups and dependencies.

sha256:593f5ce3eb3e877e44a18f385de58e432.en: Godot Engine is an open-source, multi-platform game engine supporting both 2D and 3D game development. It provides a complete development environment with visual editors, scripting support, and cross-platform deployment capabilities. The engine uses a scene system for organizing game elements and supports multiple programming languages including GDScript, C#, and C++. It can export games to desktop, mobile, web, and console platforms.
sha256:593f5ce3eb3e877e44a18f385de58e432.zh: Godot Engine 是一款开源的多平台游戏引擎，支持 2D 和 3D 游戏开发。该引擎提供完整的开发环境，包含可视化编辑器、脚本支持以及跨平台部署功能。引擎采用场景系统组织游戏元素，支持多种编程语言包括 GDScript、C# 和 C++。能够将游戏导出到桌面、移动设备、网页和游戏主机等多个平台。引擎采用节点架构设计，具有灵活的游戏对象管理方式。
sha256:593f5ce3eb3e877e44a18f385de58e432.es: Godot Engine is an open-source, multi-platform game engine supporting both 2D and 3D game development. It provides a complete development environment with visual editors, scripting support, and cross-platform deployment capabilities. The engine uses a scene system for organizing game elements and supports multiple programming languages including GDScript, C#, and C++. It can export games to desktop, mobile, web, and console platforms.

sha256:5342fd8c4de08e38562a2553b4515b384.en: FreeDomain is an open-source project providing free domain name services. The platform offers domain registration and management capabilities without cost to users. It appears to be part of the DigitalPlat ecosystem, focusing on making domain acquisition accessible. The service aims to eliminate financial barriers typically associated with domain ownership while maintaining basic domain functionality.
sha256:5342fd8c4de08e38562a2553b4515b384.zh: FreeDomain 是一个开源项目，提供免费的域名服务。该平台为用户提供无需费用的域名注册和管理功能。项目似乎是 DigitalPlat 生态系统的一部分，专注于让域名获取更加普及。该服务旨在消除通常与域名所有权相关的财务障碍，同时保持基本的域名功能。项目支持用户获取和管理域名，无需支付传统域名注册费用。

sha256:dc1da42e303e99869ad65269be66c3139.en: Microsoft Terminal is a modern, open-source command-line application for Windows that combines the original Windows console with an enhanced terminal experience. Its core capabilities include multiple tab support, GPU-accelerated text rendering, custom themes, and seamless integration with PowerShell, Command Prompt, and WSL. Key strengths are its performance optimization, extensive customization options, and cross-platform shell compatibility. Typical use cases involve system administration, development workflows, and command-line operations where users benefit from improved productivity through tab management and visual customization features.
sha256:dc1da42e303e99869ad65269be66c3139.zh: 微软终端是一款面向Windows的现代化开源命令行应用程序，将传统Windows控制台与增强型终端体验相结合。其核心功能包括多标签页支持、GPU加速文本渲染、自定义主题设置，以及与PowerShell、命令提示符和WSL的无缝集成。主要优势在于性能优化、广泛的自定义选项和跨平台shell兼容性。典型应用场景涵盖系统管理、开发工作流和命令行操作，用户可通过标签管理和视觉定制功能显著提升工作效率。该工具特别适合需要同时处理多个命令行会话的开发者和IT专业人员。
sha256:dc1da42e303e99869ad65269be66c3139.es: Microsoft Terminal is a modern, open-source command-line application for Windows that combines the original Windows console with an enhanced terminal experience. Its core capabilities include multiple tab support, GPU-accelerated text rendering, custom themes, and seamless integration with PowerShell, Command Prompt, and WSL. Key strengths are its performance optimization, extensive customization options, and cross-platform shell compatibility. Typical use cases involve system administration, development workflows, and command-line operations where users benefit from improved productivity through tab management and visual customization features.

sha256:629fb8e6a3061a9f3a3b04fdbbae7122a.en: DeepSeek-V3 is a large language model developed by DeepSeek AI, designed for advanced natural language processing tasks. Its core capabilities include text generation, translation, question answering, and code generation. Strengths lie in its massive parameter scale, multilingual support, and strong performance across diverse benchmarks. Typical use cases encompass AI assistants, content creation, programming aids, and research applications. The model represents a significant advancement in open-source AI technology, providing powerful language understanding and generation abilities for both commercial and academic purposes.
sha256:629fb8e6a3061a9f3a3b04fdbbae7122a.zh: DeepSeek-V3是由深度求索公司开发的大型语言模型，旨在处理复杂的自然语言任务。其核心能力包括文本生成、多语言翻译、智能问答和代码编写。主要优势在于庞大的参数规模、出色的多语言处理能力以及在各类基准测试中的优异表现。典型应用场景涵盖智能助手开发、内容创作辅助、编程工具支持以及学术研究。该模型代表了开源人工智能技术的重要进展，为商业应用和学术研究提供了强大的语言理解与生成能力，支持多种实际应用需求。
sha256:629fb8e6a3061a9f3a3b04fdbbae7122a.es: DeepSeek-V3 is a large language model developed by DeepSeek AI, designed for advanced natural language processing tasks. sha256:d81ed1ca220c1ac52a563ede61bfc84de.en: Microsoft's Generative AI for Beginners is a comprehensive educational resource consisting of 21 lessons designed to introduce foundational concepts in generative AI. The curriculum covers key topics including language models, transformers, prompt engineering, and semantic search. It provides practical guidance for building applications using technologies like GPT and DALL-E, with integration examples for Azure cloud services. The project serves as a structured learning path for developers new to AI development, offering hands-on exercises and implementation examples.
sha256:d81ed1ca220c1ac52a563ede61bfc84de.zh: 微软的生成式AI初学者教程是一个全面的教育资源，包含21节课程，旨在介绍生成式AI的基础概念。课程涵盖语言模型、Transformer架构、提示工程和语义搜索等关键技术主题。该项目为初学者提供使用GPT和DALL-E等技术的实践指导，包含Azure云服务的集成示例。教程采用结构化学习方法，包含动手练习和实际实现案例，帮助开发者系统掌握生成式AI应用的开发技能。内容注重基础概念理解和实际应用能力培养。
sha256:d81ed1ca220c1ac52a563ede61bfc84de.es: Microsoft's Generative AI for Beginners is a comprehensive educational resource consisting of 21 lessons designed to introduce foundational concepts in generative AI. The curriculum covers key topics including language models, transformers, prompt engineering, and semantic search. It provides practical guidance for building applications using technologies like GPT and DALL-E, with integration examples for Azure cloud services. sha256:392caa7739c09aef84b2d9da4eb17361d.en: FRP is a fast reverse proxy written in Go that enables users to expose local servers behind NAT or firewalls to the internet. It supports various proxy protocols including HTTP and TCP, facilitating secure tunneling for internal services. The tool provides P2P capabilities and can bypass network restrictions to make local development servers publicly accessible. FRP is designed for simplicity and performance, allowing developers to share local web applications or APIs without complex network configuration. It serves as a practical solution for testing and deployment scenarios.
sha256:392caa7739c09aef84b2d9da4eb17361d.zh: FRP是一个用Go语言编写的快速反向代理工具，能够帮助用户将位于NAT或防火墙后的本地服务器暴露到互联网。它支持HTTP和TCP等多种代理协议，为内部服务提供安全隧道功能。该工具具备P2P能力，可以绕过网络限制，使本地开发服务器能够被公开访问。FRP设计简洁高效，无需复杂网络配置即可共享本地Web应用或API接口。它为解决开发和测试环境中的网络访问问题提供了实用解决方案，特别适用于需要临时公开本地服务的场景。
sha256:392caa7739c09aef84b2d9da4eb17361d.es: FRP is a fast reverse proxy written in Go that enables users to expose local servers behind NAT or firewalls to the internet. It supports various proxy protocols including HTTP and TCP, facilitating secure tunneling for internal services. The tool provides P2P capabilities and can bypass network restrictions to make local development servers publicly accessible. FRP is designed for simplicity and performance, allowing developers to share local web applications or APIs without complex network configuration. It serves as a practical solution for testing and deployment scenarios.

sha256:568de31f13c0ac354b2c2c367d5b6aa43.en: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust that supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. It functions as a self-hosted alternative to commercial solutions like TeamViewer, featuring P2P connections, RDP and VNC support, and cross-platform compatibility. The project emphasizes privacy and user control by allowing local deployment of servers.
sha256:568de31f13c0ac354b2c2c367d5b6aa43.zh: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 语言编写的开源远程桌面应用程序，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 和 iOS 等多个平台。作为 TeamViewer 等商业解决方案的自托管替代品，它具有点对点连接、RDP 和 VNC 支持以及跨平台兼容性等特点。该项目强调隐私和用户控制，允许本地部署服务器，无需依赖第三方服务。
sha256:568de31f13c0ac354b2c2c367d5b6aa43.es: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust that supports multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. It functions as a self-hosted alternative to commercial solutions like TeamViewer, featuring P2P connections, RDP and VNC support, and cross-platform compatibility. The project emphasizes privacy and user control by allowing local deployment of servers.

sha256:6cffc0f09bedcebf7da08c8a9736714f6.en: Angular is a TypeScript-based open-source web application framework maintained by Google. It enables developers to build single-page applications and progressive web apps with features like dependency injection, component-based architecture, and comprehensive tooling. The framework provides structured development patterns for creating scalable, maintainable web applications across various platforms.
sha256:6cffc0f09bedcebf7da08c8a9736714f6.zh: Angular 是由 Google 维护的基于 TypeScript 的开源 Web 应用程序框架。它使开发人员能够构建单页应用程序和渐进式 Web 应用，具有依赖注入、基于组件的架构和全面的工具链等功能。该框架提供了结构化的开发模式，用于在各种平台上创建可扩展、可维护的 Web 应用程序，支持现代 Web 开发需求。
sha256:6cffc0f09bedcebf7da08c8a9736714f6.es: Angular is a TypeScript-based open-source web application framework maintained by Google. sha256:77faa6355d0f523714d4b8391ab425c09.en: Awesome-Hacking is a GitHub repository that aggregates curated lists of resources for cybersecurity professionals. It covers multiple security domains including penetration testing, bug bounty hunting, reverse engineering, and fuzzing. The collection provides tools, tutorials, and references for various platforms like Android and Windows. With over 98,000 stars, it serves as a comprehensive reference for security researchers and ethical hackers seeking organized security-related content.
sha256:77faa6355d0f523714d4b8391ab425c09.zh: Awesome-Hacking 是一个 GitHub 仓库，汇集了为网络安全专业人员整理的精选资源列表。它涵盖多个安全领域，包括渗透测试、漏洞赏金猎取、逆向工程和模糊测试。该集合提供了针对 Android 和 Windows 等各种平台的工具、教程和参考资料。拥有超过 98,000 颗星标，它作为安全研究人员和道德黑客寻找有组织安全相关内容的综合参考资源。该资源库持续更新，帮助用户访问最新的安全工具和技术信息。

sha256:e2987ab960f6d2c0ff2625d5c3647262f.en: IPTV is a GitHub repository containing a comprehensive collection of publicly available IPTV channels from global sources. It provides M3U playlist files with streaming links for television channels worldwide. The project organizes TV streams by categories and countries, enabling users to access diverse broadcast content. With nearly 100,000 stars, it serves as a centralized resource for IPTV enthusiasts and developers working with streaming media applications and services.
sha256:e2987ab960f6d2c0ff2625d5c3647262f.zh: IPTV 是一个 GitHub 仓库，包含来自全球来源的公开可用 IPTV 频道的全面集合。它提供带有全球电视频道流媒体链接的 M3U 播放列表文件。该项目按类别和国家组织电视流，使用户能够访问多样化的广播内容。拥有近 100,000 颗星标，它作为 IPTV 爱好者和从事流媒体应用程序与服务开发的开发者的集中资源。该集合持续维护更新，帮助用户发现和访问各种国际电视流媒体资源。

sha256:a28411c3113a0fee99080ef62979c44ea.en: Tauri is an open-source framework for building desktop and mobile applications using web technologies. It enables developers to create smaller, faster, and more secure native applications by combining a web frontend with a Rust backend. The framework supports multiple platforms and uses system webviews for rendering, resulting in lightweight applications with native performance. Tauri provides tools for building, bundling, and deploying applications across different operating systems while maintaining security best practices.
sha256:a28411c3113a0fee99080ef62979c44ea.zh: Tauri 是一个开源框架，用于使用 Web 技术构建桌面和移动应用程序。它允许开发者通过将 Web 前端与 Rust 后端相结合，创建更小、更快、更安全的原生应用。该框架支持多平台，并使用系统 Webview 进行渲染，从而实现轻量级应用并保持原生性能。Tauri 提供了构建、打包和部署应用程序的工具，支持跨不同操作系统运行，同时遵循安全最佳实践。该项目的核心优势在于其高效性和安全性，特别适合需要原生性能的 Web 应用开发。
sha256:a28411c3113a0fee99080ef62979c44ea.es: Tauri is an open-source framework for building desktop and mobile applications using web technologies. It enables developers to create smaller, faster, and more secure native applications by combining a web frontend with a Rust backend. The framework supports multiple platforms and uses system webviews for rendering, resulting in lightweight applications with native performance. Tauri provides tools for building, bundling, and deploying applications across different operating systems while maintaining security best practices.

sha256:0254a57020b1703fe9a3b508f22cf48a6.en: Material UI is a comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design system. It provides a complete set of pre-built, customizable UI components for building modern web applications. The library includes components for layout, navigation, data display, input controls, and feedback elements. Material UI follows Material Design guidelines to ensure consistent user interfaces across different applications. It offers theming capabilities, accessibility features, and extensive documentation to help developers create professional-looking applications efficiently.
sha256:0254a57020b1703fe9a3b508f22cf48a6.zh: Material UI 是一个全面的 React 组件库，实现了 Google 的 Material Design 设计系统。它提供了一套完整的预构建、可自定义的 UI 组件，用于构建现代 Web 应用程序。该库包含布局、导航、数据显示、输入控件和反馈元素等组件。Material UI 遵循 Material Design 指南，确保不同应用程序之间用户界面的一致性。它提供主题定制功能、无障碍访问特性和广泛的文档，帮助开发者高效创建具有专业外观的应用程序。该库持续维护并免费提供，支持快速开发符合现代设计标准的用户界面。

sha256:4497c7d139e7e463d9fe5f7e0f01c7992.en: Ant Design is an enterprise-class UI design language and React component library built with TypeScript. With over 96,000 GitHub stars, it serves as a complete design system for building professional web applications with React.

sha256:f92dc4359b2f4e85fa5c5bb5537db4d3f.en: shadcn/ui is a collection of beautifully designed, accessible React components built on Radix UI and Tailwind CSS. The project provides copy-paste components rather than installed packages, offering flexibility in implementation. With over 95,000 GitHub stars, it focuses on developer experience and component reusability across different project setups.

sha256:18175b66c38c9679b889ea64d31c7f9d4.en: HowToCook is a GitHub repository providing cooking guidance for programmers preparing meals at home. The project contains recipes and cooking methods written exclusively in Simplified Chinese. It has gained significant popularity with over 94,000 stars and 10,000 forks. The content focuses on practical cooking instructions without marketing language, serving as a straightforward culinary reference for Chinese-speaking programmers interested in home cooking.
sha256:18175b66c38c9679b889ea64d31c7f9d4.zh: HowToCook 是一个 GitHub 开源项目，专门为程序员提供在家烹饪的指导手册。该项目包含各种菜谱和烹饪方法，所有内容均以简体中文编写。项目获得了广泛关注，拥有超过 9.4 万星标和 1 万次复刻。内容聚焦于实用的烹饪指导，不包含营销内容，为中文程序员群体提供了一个直接有效的家庭烹饪参考资源。

sha256:a12e33afd2df0a67fd7b4e99470603b9b.en: Puppeteer is a Node.js library providing a high-level API to control Chrome or Chromium browsers programmatically. It enables automated web page interaction, including navigation, form submission, and screenshot capture. The tool supports both headless and headed browser modes, facilitating web scraping, automated testing, and performance monitoring. It also offers access to Chrome DevTools Protocol for debugging and optimization tasks.
sha256:a12e33afd2df0a67fd7b4e99470603b9b.zh: Puppeteer 是一个 Node.js 库，提供高级 API 以编程方式控制 Chrome 或 Chromium 浏览器。它支持自动化网页交互，包括导航、表单提交和截图捕获。该工具可在无头或有头浏览器模式下运行，适用于网页抓取、自动化测试和性能监控。它还提供对 Chrome DevTools 协议的访问，用于调试和优化任务。
sha256:a12e33afd2df0a67fd7b4e99470603b9b.es: Puppeteer is a Node.js library providing a high-level API to control Chrome or Chromium browsers programmatically. It enables automated web page interaction, including navigation, form submission, and screenshot capture. The tool supports both headless and headed browser modes, facilitating web scraping, automated testing, and performance monitoring. It also offers access to Chrome DevTools Protocol for debugging and optimization tasks.

sha256:46a079c52bd1b23b90a2e7be81ec6798a.en: Web-Dev-For-Beginners is a comprehensive 12-week curriculum comprising 24 lessons designed to teach fundamental web development skills. The course covers core technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript through practical projects and exercises. It provides structured learning materials with hands-on coding activities to build foundational knowledge in web development. The curriculum is suitable for individuals starting their programming journey in web technologies.

sha256:7c7ae5efc77597111ee191dbe64efc5e8.en: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework designed for rapid user interface development. Created by Tailwind Labs, it provides a comprehensive set of utility classes that enable developers to build custom designs directly in their markup. The framework integrates with PostCSS and supports responsive design principles. With over 90,000 GitHub stars, it has become a popular choice for modern web development workflows, offering an alternative to traditional CSS methodologies.
sha256:7c7ae5efc77597111ee191dbe64efc5e8.zh: Tailwind CSS是由Tailwind Labs开发的实用优先CSS框架，专为快速用户界面开发而设计。该框架提供了一套完整的实用工具类集合，允许开发人员直接在标记语言中构建自定义设计。它集成了PostCSS预处理工具，并支持响应式设计原则。作为传统CSS方法的替代方案，该框架在现代网页开发工作流程中广受欢迎，在GitHub上已获得超过9万星标，成为前端开发领域的重要工具。
sha256:7c7ae5efc77597111ee191dbe64efc5e8.es: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework designed for rapid user interface development. Created by Tailwind Labs, it provides a comprehensive set of utility classes that enable developers to build custom designs directly in their markup. The framework integrates with PostCSS and supports responsive design principles. With over 90,000 GitHub stars, it has become a popular choice for modern web development workflows, offering an alternative to traditional CSS methodologies.

sha256:a5431c6271f13e7f7cda383af5279a6ba.en: FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building APIs with high performance. It leverages Python type hints, Pydantic for data validation, and automatic OpenAPI/Swagger documentation generation. Built on Starlette and supporting async/await, it enables rapid development of production-ready REST APIs. The framework integrates with JSON Schema and provides interactive API docs via ReDoc and Swagger UI.
sha256:a5431c6271f13e7f7cda383af5279a6ba.zh: FastAPI 是一个现代化的 Python Web 框架，专为构建高性能 API 而设计。它利用 Python 类型提示和 Pydantic 进行数据验证，并自动生成 OpenAPI/Swagger 文档。基于 Starlette 构建，支持异步/等待模式，能够快速开发生产就绪的 REST API。该框架与 JSON Schema 集成，并通过 ReDoc 和 Swagger UI 提供交互式 API 文档。
sha256:a5431c6271f13e7f7cda383af5279a6ba.es: FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building APIs with high performance. It leverages Python type hints, Pydantic for data validation, and automatic OpenAPI/Swagger documentation generation. Built on Starlette and supporting async/await, it enables rapid development of production-ready REST APIs. The framework integrates with JSON Schema and provides interactive API docs via ReDoc and Swagger UI.

sha256:09758482e0fc36368a7c26835da58d644.en: Vue Element Admin is a frontend administration dashboard template built with Vue.js and Element UI. It provides a comprehensive management system interface with features including internationalization (i18n), data visualization, and mock data support. The project integrates various libraries like Vuex for state management, Axios for HTTP requests, and Webpack for building. It serves as a starter template for enterprise backend management systems.
sha256:09758482e0fc36368a7c26835da58d644.zh: Vue Element Admin 是一个基于 Vue.js 和 Element UI 构建的前端管理仪表板模板。它提供完整的管理系统界面，包含国际化(i18n)、数据可视化和模拟数据支持等功能。该项目集成了多种库，如用于状态管理的 Vuex、用于 HTTP 请求的 Axios 和用于构建的 Webpack。它可作为企业级后台管理系统的入门模板使用。
sha256:09758482e0fc36368a7c26835da58d644.es: Vue Element Admin is a frontend administration dashboard template built with Vue.js and Element UI. It provides a comprehensive management system interface with features including internationalization (i18n), data visualization, and mock data support. The project integrates various libraries like Vuex for state management, Axios for HTTP requests, and Webpack for building. It serves as a starter template for enterprise backend management systems.

sha256:b8c1b8759e465116e4e50d875797c15a1.en: ComfyUI is a powerful and modular interface for diffusion models, featuring a graph and nodes-based system. It serves as a GUI, API, and backend for AI applications, built with Python and PyTorch. The project supports Stable Diffusion workflows, enabling users to create complex image generation pipelines through visual programming. With high GitHub engagement, it provides flexible tools for developers and researchers working with generative AI models.
sha256:b8c1b8759e465116e4e50d875797c15a1.zh: ComfyUI 是一个基于图形节点界面的强大模块化扩散模型工具，提供 GUI、API 和后端功能。该项目使用 Python 和 PyTorch 构建，专门支持 Stable Diffusion 工作流，允许用户通过可视化编程创建复杂的图像生成流程。作为开源项目，它具有高度可定制性，适合开发者和研究人员构建生成式 AI 应用。其模块化设计便于扩展和集成各种 AI 模型组件。
sha256:b8c1b8759e465116e4e50d875797c15a1.es: ComfyUI is a powerful and modular interface for diffusion models, featuring a graph and nodes-based system. It serves as a GUI, API, and backend for AI applications, built with Python and PyTorch. The project supports Stable Diffusion workflows, enabling users to create complex image generation pipelines through visual programming. With high GitHub engagement, it provides flexible tools for developers and researchers working with generative AI models.

sha256:b204486a4c07f2eb3698543f572ed4959.en: Supabase is an open-source development platform centered around PostgreSQL database. It provides dedicated Postgres instances for building web, mobile, and AI applications with features including authentication, real-time capabilities, and vector embeddings support. The platform offers Firebase alternatives with tools like PostgREST, OAuth2, and WebSockets integration. It supports vector operations through pgvector extension, making it suitable for AI applications requiring database functionality with modern development features.
sha256:b204486a4c07f2eb3698543f572ed4959.zh: Supabase 是一个以 PostgreSQL 数据库为核心的开发平台，为构建 Web、移动和 AI 应用提供专用数据库服务。该平台包含身份验证、实时数据同步、向量嵌入支持等功能，集成了 PostgREST、OAuth2 和 WebSocket 等工具。通过 pgvector 扩展支持向量操作，适用于需要数据库功能的 AI 应用开发。作为 Firebase 的开源替代方案，它提供了完整的后端解决方案，支持现代应用开发需求。
sha256:b204486a4c07f2eb3698543f572ed4959.es: Supabase is an open-source development platform centered around PostgreSQL database. It provides dedicated Postgres instances for building web, mobile, and AI applications with features including authentication, real-time capabilities, and vector embeddings support. The platform offers Firebase alternatives with tools like PostgREST, OAuth2, and WebSockets integration. It supports vector operations through pgvector extension, making it suitable for AI applications requiring database functionality with modern development features.

sha256:0b779b93c06fc84fbcdba0ba20483e7f5.en: Awesome-Mac is a comprehensive GitHub repository that collects and organizes premium software applications specifically for macOS systems. It has evolved significantly from its original concept and now serves as an extensive curated list of desktop applications across various categories. The project maintains high popularity with nearly 89,000 stars and over 6,700 forks, indicating strong community interest in discovering quality Mac software.
sha256:0b779b93c06fc84fbcdba0ba20483e7f5.zh: Awesome-Mac 是一个 GitHub 上的开源项目，专门收集和整理适用于 macOS 系统的优质软件应用程序。该项目已从最初的概念发展壮大，现已成为涵盖各类桌面应用的全面精选列表。该资源库拥有近 89,000 个星标和超过 6,700 次分叉，显示出社区对发现高质量 Mac 软件的强烈兴趣，为 macOS 用户提供了便捷的软件发现和参考平台。
sha256:0b779b93c06fc84fbcdba0ba20483e7f5.es: Awesome-Mac is a comprehensive GitHub repository that collects and organizes premium software applications specifically for macOS systems. sha256:c3b16ab1aba684a34d6e57f5fb9a336ca.en: Whisper is OpenAI's open-source speech recognition system that achieves robust performance through large-scale weak supervision training. The model demonstrates strong capabilities in transcribing speech across various conditions and languages. With over 88,000 GitHub stars and 11,000 forks, it represents a significant advancement in automatic speech recognition technology, providing researchers and developers with access to state-of-the-art speech-to-text capabilities.
sha256:c3b16ab1aba684a34d6e57f5fb9a336ca.zh: Whisper 是 OpenAI 开发的开源语音识别系统，通过大规模弱监督训练实现了强大的性能表现。该模型在各种条件和多种语言环境下均展现出优异的语音转文本能力。该项目在 GitHub 上获得超过 88,000 个星标和 11,000 次分叉，代表了自动语音识别技术的重要进展，为研究者和开发者提供了先进的语音转文本工具，支持多语言语音处理应用。
sha256:c3b16ab1aba684a34d6e57f5fb9a336ca.es: Whisper is OpenAI's open-source speech recognition system that achieves robust performance through large-scale weak supervision training. The model demonstrates strong capabilities in transcribing speech across various conditions and languages. With over 88,000 GitHub stars and 11,000 forks, it represents a significant advancement in automatic speech recognition technology, providing researchers and developers with access to state-of-the-art speech-to-text capabilities.

sha256:5d94f90d88fc744cb03e11aafbb52903a.en: This GitHub repository systematically collects and organizes system prompts, internal tools, and AI models from various AI coding assistants and development platforms. It covers major tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Replit, Devin AI, and open-source alternatives. The collection serves as a comprehensive reference for developers and researchers to understand how different AI coding tools operate, their underlying mechanisms, and implementation approaches. With over 88,000 stars, it has become a valuable community resource for studying AI-assisted development workflows and tool architectures.
sha256:5d94f90d88fc744cb03e11aafbb52903a.zh: 该GitHub仓库系统性地收集整理了各类AI编程助手和开发平台的系统提示词、内部工具及AI模型。涵盖Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Replit、Devin AI等主流工具及开源替代方案。作为开发者与研究者的重要参考资料，帮助理解不同AI编程工具的工作原理、底层机制与实现方式。该仓库拥有超过8.8万星标，已成为研究AI辅助开发工作流程和工具架构的宝贵社区资源，为技术探索和工具开发提供实践参考。

sha256:c1bcb8395b4c469a1acfcfa4b97c7bca5.en: Storybook is an open-source tool for developing UI components in isolation. It enables developers to build, document, and test components separately from the main application. Core capabilities include creating interactive component stories, visual testing, and documentation generation. Strengths include support for multiple frameworks (React, Vue, Angular), visual testing tools, and addon ecosystem. Typical use cases include component development, design system implementation, visual regression testing, and team collaboration on UI components.
sha256:c1bcb8395b4c469a1acfcfa4b97c7bca5.zh: Storybook 是一个用于独立开发 UI 组件的开源工具。它允许开发者在隔离环境中构建、记录和测试组件，无需依赖主应用程序。核心功能包括创建交互式组件故事、视觉测试和文档自动生成。主要优势包括支持多种框架（React、Vue、Angular 等）、强大的视觉测试工具和丰富的插件生态系统。典型应用场景包括组件开发、设计系统实施、视觉回归测试以及团队在 UI 组件上的协作开发，特别适用于大型前端项目和组件库的维护。
sha256:c1bcb8395b4c469a1acfcfa4b97c7bca5.es: Storybook is an open-source tool for developing UI components in isolation. It enables developers to build, document, and test components separately from the main application. Core capabilities include creating interactive component stories, visual testing, and documentation generation. Strengths include support for multiple frameworks (React, Vue, Angular), visual testing tools, and addon ecosystem. Typical use cases include component development, design system implementation, visual regression testing, and team collaboration on UI components.

sha256:8a3c2d395120c31aeeb5a8236779a55ef.en: v2rayN is a GUI client application for Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems that supports multiple proxy protocols including Xray, sing-box, V2Ray, VLESS, VMess, Trojan, and Shadowsocks. The project provides a user-friendly interface for configuring and managing proxy connections, enabling users to establish secure network tunnels. It serves as a comprehensive proxy management tool with cross-platform compatibility and extensive protocol support for various networking needs.
sha256:8a3c2d395120c31aeeb5a8236779a55ef.zh: v2rayN 是一款适用于 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 操作系统的图形用户界面客户端应用程序，支持多种代理协议，包括 Xray、sing-box、V2Ray、VLESS、VMess、Trojan 和 Shadowsocks。该项目提供了一个用户友好的界面，用于配置和管理代理连接，使用户能够建立安全的网络隧道。它作为一个全面的代理管理工具，具有跨平台兼容性和广泛的协议支持，满足各种网络需求。该项目在 GitHub 上拥有大量关注者和贡献者。
sha256:8a3c2d395120c31aeeb5a8236779a55ef.es: v2rayN is a GUI client application for Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems that supports multiple proxy protocols including Xray, sing-box, V2Ray, VLESS, VMess, Trojan, and Shadowsocks. The project provides a user-friendly interface for configuring and managing proxy connections, enabling users to establish secure network tunnels. It serves as a comprehensive proxy management tool with cross-platform compatibility and extensive protocol support for various networking needs.

sha256:4f419eb1642f48b326e622fb1c784feb6.en: nvm is a POSIX-compliant bash script that functions as a Node.js version manager, allowing users to install and manage multiple active Node.js versions simultaneously. The tool supports various shell environments including bash and zsh, and enables easy switching between different Node.js versions including LTS releases. It provides commands for installing, uninstalling, and switching Node.js versions, along with support for .nvmrc files for project-specific version management in development workflows.
sha256:4f419eb1642f48b326e622fb1c784feb6.zh: nvm 是一个符合 POSIX 标准的 bash 脚本，作为 Node.js 版本管理器，允许用户同时安装和管理多个活动的 Node.js 版本。该工具支持包括 bash 和 zsh 在内的各种 shell 环境，并能够轻松在不同 Node.js 版本（包括 LTS 版本）之间切换。它提供了安装、卸载和切换 Node.js 版本的命令，同时支持 .nvmrc 文件用于开发工作流中特定项目的版本管理。该项目在 GitHub 上拥有广泛的用户基础和社区支持。
sha256:4f419eb1642f48b326e622fb1c784feb6.es: nvm is a POSIX-compliant bash script that functions as a Node.js version manager, allowing users to install and manage multiple active Node.js versions simultaneously. The tool supports various shell environments including bash and zsh, and enables easy switching between different Node.js versions including LTS releases. It provides commands for installing, uninstalling, and switching Node.js versions, along with support for .nvmrc files for project-specific version management in development workflows.

sha256:2ac4fe430467f7601c8647ae263d2458b.en: MobileNetV3-Small 100 is a lightweight convolutional neural network optimized for mobile and edge devices. It uses depthwise separable convolutions and squeeze-and-excitation modules to reduce computational cost while maintaining accuracy. The model achieves efficient image classification with minimal parameters and FLOPs. Trained on ImageNet-1K using the LAMB optimizer, it provides strong performance for resource-constrained applications. Typical use cases include mobile vision tasks, embedded systems, and real-time image recognition where computational efficiency is critical.

sha256:2ac4fe430467f7601c8647ae263d2458b.es: MobileNetV3-Small 100 is a lightweight convolutional neural network optimized for mobile and edge devices. It uses depthwise separable convolutions and squeeze-and-excitation modules to reduce computational cost while maintaining accuracy. The model achieves efficient image classification with minimal parameters and FLOPs. Trained on ImageNet-1K using the LAMB optimizer, it provides strong performance for resource-constrained applications. Typical use cases include mobile vision tasks, embedded systems, and real-time image recognition where computational efficiency is critical.

sha256:2680e91b450530dd5454746fe18ff86be.en: This project provides an image classification model designed to detect NSFW (Not Safe For Work) content in images. Built on Vision Transformer architecture, it can identify explicit or inappropriate visual material with high accuracy. Core capabilities include binary classification of images as safe or unsafe, leveraging transfer learning from pre-trained models. Its strengths include robust performance across diverse image types and efficient processing. Typical use cases include content moderation for social platforms, parental control applications, and automated filtering systems to maintain safe digital environments by preventing exposure to inappropriate visual content.
sha256:2680e91b450530dd5454746fe18ff86be.zh: 该项目提供了一种图像分类模型，专门用于检测图像中的NSFW（不适合工作场所）内容。基于Vision Transformer架构构建，能够以高精度识别露骨或不适当的视觉材料。核心功能包括对图像进行安全或不安全的二元分类，利用预训练模型的迁移学习能力。其优势在于对各种图像类型的稳健性能表现和高效处理能力。典型应用场景包括社交媒体平台的内容审核、家长控制应用程序以及自动过滤系统，通过防止接触不适当视觉内容来维护安全的数字环境，适用
sha256:2680e91b450530dd5454746fe18ff86be.es: This project provides an image classification model designed to detect NSFW (Not Safe For Work) content in images. Built on Vision Transformer architecture, it can identify explicit or inappropriate visual material with high accuracy. Core capabilities include binary classification of images as safe or unsafe, leveraging transfer learning from pre-trained models. Its strengths include robust performance across diverse image types and efficient processing. Typical use cases include content moderation for social platforms, parental control applications, and automated filtering systems to maintain safe digital environments by preventing exposure to inappropriate visual content.

sha256:473634331bb524d198ac8bee2dacec610.en: The all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model is a compact sentence transformer designed for efficient text embedding generation. It converts sentences into 384-dimensional vector representations optimized for semantic similarity tasks. Core capabilities include semantic search, clustering, and retrieval-augmented generation. Strengths include its small size (22MB), fast inference speed, and competitive performance despite minimal parameters. Typical use cases encompass document retrieval, duplicate detection, recommendation systems, and natural language understanding applications where computational efficiency is prioritized.
sha256:473634331bb524d198ac8bee2dacec610.zh: all-MiniLM-L6-v2模型是一种紧凑型句子转换器，专为高效生成文本嵌入而设计。该模型将句子转换为384维向量表示，优化用于语义相似性任务。核心能力包括语义搜索、文本聚类和检索增强生成。主要优势在于模型体积小（22MB）、推理速度快，尽管参数最少但仍保持竞争力。典型应用场景涵盖文档检索、重复检测、推荐系统以及需要优先考虑计算效率的自然语言理解应用，特别适合资源受限环境下的部署需求。
sha256:473634331bb524d198ac8bee2dacec610.es: The all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model is a compact sentence transformer designed for efficient text embedding generation. It converts sentences into 384-dimensional vector representations optimized for semantic similarity tasks. Core capabilities include semantic search, clustering, and retrieval-augmented generation. Strengths include its small size (22MB), fast inference speed, and competitive performance despite minimal parameters. Typical use cases encompass document retrieval, duplicate detection, recommendation systems, and natural language understanding applications where computational efficiency is prioritized.

sha256:82fd2dbc9b431cdab734d1f3afd66f974.en: This project fine-tunes Google's Vision Transformer (ViT) model on the FairFace dataset to classify human age from facial images. Its core capability is predicting age groups across diverse demographics, addressing fairness in computer vision. Strengths include robust performance on varied skin tones and ethnicities, leveraging ViT's attention mechanisms for detailed feature extraction. Typical use cases span demographic analysis, age-appropriate content filtering, and bias mitigation in facial recognition systems. The model is compatible with Transformers and supports SafeTensors, ensuring efficient deployment.
sha256:82fd2dbc9b431cdab734d1f3afd66f974.zh: 该项目基于谷歌Vision Transformer（ViT）模型，在FairFace数据集上进行微调，用于从人脸图像中分类年龄。核心能力是预测不同人口统计群体的年龄组，解决计算机视觉中的公平性问题。优势包括对多种肤色和种族的鲁棒性能，利用ViT的注意力机制提取详细特征。典型应用涵盖人口统计分析、年龄适宜内容过滤以及面部识别系统中的偏见缓解。该模型兼容Transformers库，支持SafeTensors格式，确保高效部署，适用于需要公平年龄检测的场景。
sha256:82fd2dbc9b431cdab734d1f3afd66f974.es: This project fine-tunes Google's Vision Transformer (ViT) model on the FairFace dataset to classify human age from facial images. Its core capability is predicting age groups across diverse demographics, addressing fairness in computer vision. Strengths include robust performance on varied skin tones and ethnicities, leveraging ViT's attention mechanisms for detailed feature extraction. Typical use cases span demographic analysis, age-appropriate content filtering, and bias mitigation in facial recognition systems. The model is compatible with Transformers and supports SafeTensors, ensuring efficient deployment.

sha256:3b078f80c39a790987c0e16d76d717c44.en: BERT-base-uncased is a foundational transformer model pre-trained on English Wikipedia and BookCorpus using masked language modeling and next sentence prediction. Its core capabilities include text understanding, semantic analysis, and contextual embedding generation. Key strengths are bidirectional context processing, transfer learning efficiency, and broad applicability across NLP tasks. Typical use cases encompass text classification, named entity recognition, question answering, and sentiment analysis, serving as a base for fine-tuning domain-specific applications.
sha256:3b078f80c39a790987c0e16d76d717c44.zh: BERT-base-uncased是基于Transformer架构的英语预训练模型，通过掩码语言建模和下一句预测任务在维基百科和BookCorpus语料上训练。核心能力包括深层文本理解、语义特征提取和上下文表征学习。主要优势在于双向语境编码、强大的迁移学习性能及多任务适应性。典型应用涵盖文本分类、命名实体识别、智能问答、情感分析等自然语言处理任务，常作为基础模型进行领域微调以提升下游任务效果。
sha256:3b078f80c39a790987c0e16d76d717c44.es: BERT-base-uncased is a foundational transformer model pre-trained on English Wikipedia and BookCorpus using masked language modeling and next sentence prediction. sha256:0159f90c5cfd41dd58a790ad75e7ffb4c.en: This YOLOv8s-based model specializes in detecting signatures within documents and images. Built on the efficient YOLOv8s architecture, it provides real-time signature localization with high accuracy. Core capabilities include bounding box detection for signature regions, optimized inference speed, and compatibility with various document formats. Strengths include lightweight deployment, ONNX runtime support, and robust performance on diverse signature styles. Typical use cases encompass automated document processing, digital archiving systems, fraud detection workflows, and compliance verification in financial and legal sectors.
sha256:0159f90c5cfd41dd58a790ad75e7ffb4c.zh: 该基于YOLOv8s的模型专门用于检测文档和图像中的签名区域。采用高效的YOLOv8s架构，能够实时准确定位签名位置。核心功能包括签名边界框检测、优化的推理速度以及多种文档格式兼容性。主要优势在于轻量级部署、ONNX运行时支持，以及对不同签名风格的鲁棒性能。典型应用场景涵盖自动化文档处理系统、数字档案管理、金融和法律领域的欺诈检测流程、合规性验证，以及需要签名识别的各类办公自动化场景。该模型特别适用于需要高效处理大量文

sha256:ff8d503f3d780d54fdfb920f323416361.en: ELECTRA-base-discriminator is a pre-trained language model developed by Google using the ELECTRA method. It employs a discriminator approach where the model learns to distinguish between real and replaced tokens rather than predicting masked tokens. The model supports multiple frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX, and is compatible with Transformers library. With over 30 million downloads, it's licensed under Apache 2.0 and primarily handles English text processing tasks.
sha256:ff8d503f3d780d54fdfb920f323416361.zh: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是由谷歌开发的预训练语言模型，采用ELECTRA方法训练。该模型使用判别器方法，学习区分真实标记和被替换标记，而非预测掩码标记。支持PyTorch、TensorFlow和JAX等多种框架，兼容Transformers库。下载量超过3000万次，采用Apache 2.0许可证，主要用于英文文本处理任务。模型基于判别式预训练方法，在多项自然语言理解任务中表现出色。

sha256:a6f100b6ea0050931a73670c6cb2b95e3.en: PyAnnote segmentation-3.0 is an audio processing model for speaker diarization and segmentation tasks. It performs voice activity detection, speaker change detection, and overlapped speech detection in audio recordings. The model is built on PyTorch framework and is part of the PyAnnote audio toolkit. With nearly 20 million downloads, it's licensed under MIT and handles various speaker-related audio analysis functions including speaker segmentation and resegmentation for diarization applications.
sha256:a6f100b6ea0050931a73670c6cb2b95e3.zh: PyAnnote segmentation-3.0是用于说话人日志和分割任务的音频处理模型。该模型执行语音活动检测、说话人变化检测和重叠语音检测功能。基于PyTorch框架构建，是PyAnnote音频工具包的一部分。下载量接近2000万次，采用MIT许可证，处理多种说话人相关的音频分析功能，包括说话人分割和重新分割，适用于说话人日志应用场景。模型专门设计用于音频流中的说话人识别和分割任务。
sha256:a6f100b6ea0050931a73670c6cb2b95e3.es: PyAnnote segmentation-3.0 is an audio processing model for speaker diarization and segmentation tasks. It performs voice activity detection, speaker change detection, and overlapped speech detection in audio recordings. The model is built on PyTorch framework and is part of the PyAnnote audio toolkit. With nearly 20 million downloads, it's licensed under MIT and handles various speaker-related audio analysis functions including speaker segmentation and resegmentation for diarization applications.

sha256:4f96f5dc4644d60ee49a7a16c3f557514.en: This model is a speaker recognition system that generates speaker embeddings from speech audio. Its core capability lies in extracting distinctive voice characteristics using a ResNet-34 architecture trained on VoxCeleb datasets. Key strengths include robust speaker verification and identification performance across diverse speaking conditions. Typical use cases encompass speaker diarization, voice authentication systems, and speaker clustering applications. The model operates by converting input audio into fixed-dimensional embeddings that capture unique speaker traits, enabling comparison and matching against known speaker profiles.
sha256:4f96f5dc4644d60ee49a7a16c3f557514.zh: 该模型是一个基于ResNet-34架构的说话人识别系统，专门用于从语音音频中提取说话人嵌入向量。核心功能是通过深度神经网络处理音频输入，生成能够区分不同说话人的特征表示。主要优势在于经过VoxCeleb数据集训练，具备较强的说话人验证和识别能力，能够适应不同的语音环境和说话风格。典型应用场景包括说话人日志记录、语音身份验证系统、说话人聚类分析以及多说话人语音分离任务。该模型将输入的语音信号转换为固定维度的嵌入向
sha256:4f96f5dc4644d60ee49a7a16c3f557514.es: This model is a speaker recognition system that generates speaker embeddings from speech audio. Its core capability lies in extracting distinctive voice characteristics using a ResNet-34 architecture trained on VoxCeleb datasets. Key strengths include robust speaker verification and identification performance across diverse speaking conditions. Typical use cases encompass speaker diarization, voice authentication systems, and speaker clustering applications. The model operates by converting input audio into fixed-dimensional embeddings that capture unique speaker traits, enabling comparison and matching against known speaker profiles.

sha256:339d572476340cc5f40dd42672512406b.en: The all-mpnet-base-v2 model generates dense vector embeddings for sentences and paragraphs, enabling semantic similarity comparisons. Its core capability lies in producing 768-dimensional embeddings optimized for cosine similarity. Key strengths include robust performance across diverse domains and efficient handling of semantic search tasks. Typical use cases encompass information retrieval, duplicate question detection, clustering similar documents, and semantic search applications. The model was trained on multiple datasets including MS MARCO, NLI, and StackExchange to ensure broad applicability.
sha256:339d572476340cc5f40dd42672512406b.zh: all-mpnet-base-v2模型专门生成句子和段落的密集向量嵌入，用于语义相似度计算。核心能力是产生768维嵌入向量，针对余弦相似度优化。主要优势包括跨领域稳健性能、高效处理语义搜索任务。典型应用场景涵盖信息检索、重复问题检测、相似文档聚类、语义搜索等。该模型在MS MARCO、自然语言推理、StackExchange等多个数据集上训练，确保广泛适用性。模型基于MPNet架构，结合了掩码语言建模和排列语言建模的优点，能够有效捕捉文本语义信息。
sha256:339d572476340cc5f40dd42672512406b.es: The all-mpnet-base-v2 model generates dense vector embeddings for sentences and paragraphs, enabling semantic similarity comparisons. sha256:f2407dde959ebe08447ab8bfe36035a82.en: Pyannote speaker-diarization-3.1 is an open-source audio processing pipeline for speaker diarization. It identifies and segments different speakers in audio recordings, detecting speaker changes and voice activity. The system also handles overlapped speech where multiple people speak simultaneously. Based on research papers arXiv:2012.01477 and arXiv:2111.14448, it uses MIT license and is compatible with various endpoints. The model has been downloaded over 16 million times from Hugging Face.
sha256:f2407dde959ebe08447ab8bfe36035a82.zh: Pyannote speaker-diarization-3.1 是一个开源音频处理管道，专门用于说话人日志分析。该系统能够识别和分割音频录音中的不同说话人，检测说话人变化和语音活动。该模型还能处理多人同时说话的重叠语音场景。基于 arXiv:2012.01477 和 arXiv:2111.14448 研究论文开发，采用 MIT 许可证，兼容多种部署端点。该模型在 Hugging Face 平台上的下载量已超过 1600 万次，支持自动语音识别相关应用。
sha256:f2407dde959ebe08447ab8bfe36035a82.es: Pyannote speaker-diarization-3.1 is an open-source audio processing pipeline for speaker diarization. It identifies and segments different speakers in audio recordings, detecting speaker changes and voice activity. The system also handles overlapped speech where multiple people speak simultaneously. Based on research papers arXiv:2012.01477 and arXiv:2111.14448, it uses MIT license and is compatible with various endpoints. The model has been downloaded over 16 million times from Hugging Face.

sha256:abf9d4d6d5f0198c4b3020794828b9066.en: ADetailer is an open-source computer vision tool for detailed image analysis and enhancement. It utilizes segmentation models trained on anime segmentation and wider face datasets to detect and process specific image regions. Built with PyTorch and licensed under Apache 2.0, the tool focuses on precise region detection and refinement. With over 14 million downloads from Hugging Face, it integrates with Ultralytics frameworks for computer vision applications requiring detailed image processing capabilities.
sha256:abf9d4d6d5f0198c4b3020794828b9066.zh: ADetailer 是一个开源计算机视觉工具，专门用于详细的图像分析和增强处理。该工具利用基于动漫分割和 Wider Face 数据集训练的 segmentation 模型来检测和处理特定的图像区域。采用 PyTorch 框架构建，使用 Apache 2.0 许可证，主要专注于精确的区域检测和精细化处理。该模型在 Hugging Face 平台上的下载量已超过 1400 万次，能够与 Ultralytics 框架集成，适用于需要详细图像处理功能的计算机视觉应用场景。
sha256:abf9d4d6d5f0198c4b3020794828b9066.es: ADetailer is an open-source computer vision tool for detailed image analysis and enhancement. With over 14 million downloads from Hugging Face, it integrates with Ultralytics frameworks for computer vision applications requiring detailed image processing capabilities.

sha256:dae4caac4aa05a1e2cb3e59fed29662df.en: CLIP-ViT-Base-Patch32 is a multimodal AI model developed by OpenAI that connects images and text through contrastive learning. Its core capability lies in understanding visual content and matching it with textual descriptions without task-specific training. The model excels at zero-shot image classification, where it can categorize images based on natural language prompts. Key strengths include strong generalization across diverse visual concepts and compatibility with multiple frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow. Typical use cases include content moderation, visual search, image captioning, and any application requiring cross-modal understanding between vision and language.
sha256:dae4caac4aa05a1e2cb3e59fed29662df.zh: CLIP-ViT-Base-Patch32是OpenAI开发的多模态人工智能模型，通过对比学习实现图像与文本的关联理解。其核心能力在于无需特定任务训练即可理解视觉内容并与文本描述匹配。该模型擅长零样本图像分类，能够根据自然语言提示对图像进行分类。主要优势包括对多样化视觉概念的强大泛化能力，以及兼容PyTorch、TensorFlow等多种框架的灵活性。典型应用场景涵盖内容审核、视觉搜索、图像描述生成，以及任何需要视觉与语言跨模态理解的任务，特别适合处理开放域视觉识别问
sha256:dae4caac4aa05a1e2cb3e59fed29662df.es: CLIP-ViT-Base-Patch32 is a multimodal AI model developed by OpenAI that connects images and text through contrastive learning. sha256:38de51a54f6d39c3ce107b2cc62ab370b.en: RoBERTa-large is a robustly optimized BERT pretraining approach developed by Facebook AI. It removes the next sentence prediction objective and trains with larger mini-batches and learning rates on more data. Core capabilities include masked language modeling for text understanding, classification, and question answering. Strengths are its improved performance over BERT across GLUE, SQuAD, and RACE benchmarks without architectural changes. Typical use cases span sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, and natural language inference tasks in English text processing applications.
sha256:38de51a54f6d39c3ce107b2cc62ab370b.zh: RoBERTa-large是由Facebook AI开发的BERT预训练方法的鲁棒优化版本。它移除了下一句预测目标，采用更大的批次大小和学习率在更多数据上进行训练。核心能力包括用于文本理解的掩码语言建模、分类和问答任务。其优势在于无需架构修改即可在GLUE、SQuAD和RACE等基准测试中超越BERT的性能表现。典型应用场景涵盖情感分析、命名实体识别和自然语言推理等英文文本处理任务，通过更高效的预训练策略实现了语言理解能力的显著提升。
sha256:38de51a54f6d39c3ce107b2cc62ab370b.es: RoBERTa-large is a robustly optimized BERT pretraining approach developed by Facebook AI. sha256:92cd0cd155b553a0ea12ab6128ed3a61d.en: GPT-2 is a transformer-based language model developed by OpenAI for text generation tasks. It uses a decoder-only architecture trained on large text corpora to predict subsequent tokens. The model is available in multiple sizes and supports various frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, and ONNX. It features MIT licensing and is compatible with text generation inference. The implementation includes safetensors format and supports multiple programming languages through the transformers library.
sha256:92cd0cd155b553a0ea12ab6128ed3a61d.zh: GPT-2是由OpenAI开发的基于Transformer架构的语言模型，专门用于文本生成任务。该模型采用仅解码器结构，通过在大规模文本语料库上进行训练来预测后续标记。提供多种规模版本，支持PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX和ONNX等多种深度学习框架。采用MIT许可证，兼容文本生成推理，包含safetensors格式支持，并可通过transformers库在多种编程语言中使用。模型基于自回归生成机制，能够根据输入提示生成连贯的文本内容。
sha256:92cd0cd155b553a0ea12ab6128ed3a61d.es: GPT-2 is a transformer-based language model developed by OpenAI for text generation tasks. sha256:37b08c4f21c129be2353ceed055c0baf3.en: RoBERTa-base is a robustly optimized BERT pretraining approach developed by Facebook AI. It supports multiple frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX with MIT licensing. Compatible with fill-mask tasks and autotrain, it implements the RoBERTa architecture improvements over original BERT through optimized training methodology and hyperparameter tuning.

sha256:3fce75ef0c137ffdf0d2d0449c96c3b29.en: DistilBERT is a distilled version of BERT designed for efficient natural language processing. It retains 97% of BERT's language understanding capabilities while being 40% smaller and 60% faster. Core capabilities include masked language modeling, text classification, and question answering. Strengths include reduced computational requirements and faster inference times. Typical use cases involve sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, and text classification where computational efficiency is prioritized over marginal accuracy gains.
sha256:3fce75ef0c137ffdf0d2d0449c96c3b29.zh: DistilBERT是BERT的蒸馏版本，专为高效自然语言处理而设计。它在保持BERT 97%语言理解能力的同时，体积缩小40%，速度提升60%。核心功能包括掩码语言建模、文本分类和问答系统。主要优势在于显著降低计算资源需求并加快推理速度。典型应用场景包括情感分析、命名实体识别和文本分类任务，特别适用于计算资源有限或需要快速响应的生产环境，在保持较高准确率的同时大幅优化性能效率。
sha256:3fce75ef0c137ffdf0d2d0449c96c3b29.es: DistilBERT is a distilled version of BERT designed for efficient natural language processing. sha256:0d73c4a7c11b889ef2b67a2414ea1d059.en: This multilingual sentence embedding model generates semantic representations for text in over 50 languages. Built on MiniLM architecture with 12 transformer layers, it creates 384-dimensional embeddings optimized for semantic similarity tasks. Its core capability is producing comparable vector representations for sentences with equivalent meanings across different languages. Key strengths include efficient computation, multilingual alignment, and strong performance on paraphrase identification. Typical use cases include cross-lingual semantic search, multilingual document clustering, duplicate detection, and content recommendation systems requiring language-agnostic text understanding.

Typical use cases include cross-lingual semantic search, multilingual document clustering, duplicate detection, and content recommendation systems requiring language-agnostic text understanding.

sha256:aafb6f900f8dce8544741e2ec8a85aeb8.en: Tarsier2-Recap-7b is a 7-billion parameter video language model developed by Omni Research, based on research from arXiv:2501.07888. It uses SafeTensors format and is licensed under Apache 2.0. The model is designed for video understanding tasks and has received over 10.7 million downloads. As a video LLM, it processes visual content to generate textual descriptions or answer questions about video content.
sha256:aafb6f900f8dce8544741e2ec8a85aeb8.zh: Tarsier2-Recap-7b是由Omni Research开发的70亿参数视频语言模型，基于arXiv:2501.07888的研究成果。该模型采用SafeTensors格式，使用Apache 2.0许可证授权。作为视频理解模型，它能够处理视觉内容并生成文本描述或回答关于视频内容的问题。该模型已获得超过1070万次下载，主要面向视频分析和理解应用场景。
sha256:aafb6f900f8dce8544741e2ec8a85aeb8.es: Tarsier2-Recap-7b is a 7-billion parameter video language model developed by Omni Research, based on research from arXiv:2501.07888. sha256:19105e62179d50688bb16f18a49c590c3.en: BERT-tiny is a minimal version of the BERT architecture designed for efficient natural language inference tasks. Based on research from arXiv:1908.08962 and arXiv:2110.01518, this English-language model is compatible with transformer endpoints and uses PyTorch. Licensed under MIT, it has achieved over 8.5 million downloads. The model supports pre-training and fine-tuning for various NLP applications while maintaining reduced computational requirements compared to full-sized BERT models.
sha256:19105e62179d50688bb16f18a49c590c3.zh: BERT-tiny是BERT架构的微型版本，专门为高效的自然语言推理任务设计。该模型基于arXiv:1908.08962和arXiv:2110.01518的研究成果，使用英语训练，兼容transformer端点并采用PyTorch框架。采用MIT许可证授权，已获得超过850万次下载。相比完整版BERT模型，该模型在保持支持预训练和微调的同时，显著降低了计算资源需求，适用于各种自然语言处理应用场景。
sha256:19105e62179d50688bb16f18a49c590c3.es: BERT-tiny is a minimal version of the BERT architecture designed for efficient natural language inference tasks. Based on research from arXiv:1908.08962 and arXiv:2110.01518, this English-language model is compatible with transformer endpoints and uses PyTorch. Licensed under MIT, it has achieved over 8.5 million downloads. The model supports pre-training and fine-tuning for various NLP applications while maintaining reduced computational requirements compared to full-sized BERT models.

sha256:6fe899c23e1243f06a8b09e7924f134e8.en: freeCodeCamp is an open-source educational platform offering a comprehensive curriculum for learning programming and computer science. The project provides free coding lessons, interactive exercises, and certification programs covering technologies like JavaScript, Node.js, React, and D3. It serves as a community-driven learning resource with extensive educational materials for self-paced study. The platform emphasizes practical skills development through hands-on coding challenges and projects.
sha256:6fe899c23e1243f06a8b09e7924f134e8.zh: freeCodeCamp是一个开源的教育平台，提供全面的编程和计算机科学学习课程。该项目包含免费的编程课程、互动练习和认证项目，涵盖JavaScript、Node.js、React和D3等技术。作为一个社区驱动的学习资源，它提供了丰富的教育材料供自主学习。平台通过实践编码挑战和项目强调实用技能培养，帮助学习者掌握从基础数学到高级编程的完整知识体系。
sha256:6fe899c23e1243f06a8b09e7924f134e8.es: freeCodeCamp is an open-source educational platform offering a comprehensive curriculum for learning programming and computer science. The project provides free coding lessons, interactive exercises, and certification programs covering technologies like JavaScript, Node.js, React, and D3. It serves as a community-driven learning resource with extensive educational materials for self-paced study. The platform emphasizes practical skills development through hands-on coding challenges and projects.

sha256:1b8a901b3e1e8a9e03f7e88accddeb90f.en: Awesome is a curated collection of high-quality lists covering various interesting topics across technology and other domains. The project serves as a comprehensive repository of resources, tools, and references organized by subject matter. It functions as a meta-list that aggregates and categorizes valuable content from diverse fields. Users can discover recommended materials, libraries, and information sources through these systematically organized collections.
sha256:1b8a901b3e1e8a9e03f7e88accddeb90f.zh: Awesome是一个精心策划的高质量列表集合，涵盖技术及其他领域的各种有趣主题。该项目作为按主题组织的资源、工具和参考资料的综合性存储库。它作为一个元列表，汇总并分类来自不同领域的宝贵内容。用户可以通过这些系统组织的集合发现推荐的材料、库和信息来源，为学习和研究提供便捷的参考指南。

sha256:8fda86442cd72f49c1b739b68f5578e74.en: The free-programming-books project is a comprehensive collection of freely available programming books covering various languages and technologies. The project includes books in multiple languages and formats, maintained through community contributions. It has gained significant popularity with over 371,000 stars and 64,000 forks on GitHub.
sha256:8fda86442cd72f49c1b739b68f5578e74.zh: free-programming-books项目是一个全面的免费编程书籍集合，涵盖多种编程语言和技术。该项目作为开发者和学习者的教育资源，以结构化仓库形式组织。包含多种语言和格式的编程书籍，通过社区贡献维护。在GitHub上获得了超过37万星标和6.4万分支，显示出广泛的受欢迎程度。该项目为编程学习者提供了丰富的免费学习材料。

sha256:234569e0da0c4b0b23dc726624a674f4e.en: The public-apis project is a collective list of free APIs organized by categories such as business, entertainment, and development tools. It provides developers with access to various public APIs for integration into applications and services. The repository includes API documentation, authentication requirements, and usage examples. With over 367,000 stars and 38,000 forks, it serves as a valuable resource for software development projects.
sha256:234569e0da0c4b0b23dc726624a674f4e.zh: public-apis项目是一个按类别组织的免费API集合列表，涵盖商业、娱乐和开发工具等多个领域。为开发者提供各种公共API的访问信息，便于集成到应用程序和服务中。该仓库包含API文档、认证要求和使用示例。在GitHub上拥有超过36万星标和3.8万分支，成为软件开发项目的重要资源库。该项目帮助开发者快速找到可用的API服务。

sha256:e2a0079488d3fa1ec2dfadff1418c51ea.en: Coding Interview University is a comprehensive computer science study plan designed to prepare individuals for software engineering roles. It covers essential topics including algorithms, data structures, and programming interview techniques. The project provides structured learning materials and practice exercises to help users develop the technical skills required for technical interviews at major technology companies. With over 330,000 stars on GitHub, it serves as a popular self-study resource for aspiring software engineers.
sha256:e2a0079488d3fa1ec2dfadff1418c51ea.zh: Coding Interview University 是一个完整的计算机科学学习计划，旨在帮助个人准备软件工程师职位的面试。该项目涵盖了算法、数据结构、编程面试技巧等核心内容，提供了系统的学习材料和练习题目。资源组织有序，帮助用户掌握技术公司面试所需的关键技能。该项目在GitHub上获得了超过33万星标，成为求职者广泛使用的自学工具，专注于技术能力的实际提升而非理论探讨。
